## 中文

### 界面与操作
- 集中优化售前、招投标、公文写作、课题申报、项目协作、论文导师、软件著作和专利模块的启象界面，统一表单、列表、按钮、弹窗与任务反馈。
- 项目列表支持点击名称查看详情，再通过“进入项目”进入工作区；补充加载与错误反馈，并修正详情抽屉顶部与窗口拖拽区域的冲突。
- 软著工作台按源码、登记信息、生成控制、草稿审阅、总检与导出分阶段展示，使用引导默认折叠，减少长页面和无关内容干扰。
- 优化章节目录、阶段产出和长内容展示，移除面向用户的目录内部标识，压缩重复的进度与完成提示。

### 设置与文档
- 统一新版设置的分组、间距和状态样式；高级模型参数和 ComfyUI 工作流可按需展开。
- 修复 Word 阅读预览中深色背景与深色文字叠加的问题，恢复白色纸张及清晰的正文、表格和代码块。
- 完善资料列表、图片预览、导出反馈及可研项目图片读取；改进无文字层 PDF 的解析提示。
- 改进版本检查的缓存与限流处理，减少重复请求及 HTTP 429 错误影响。

### 使用提示
- 本次主要调整启象界面，保留守矩模式及原有业务数据。
- Word 预览用于阅读，实际分页与排版请以导出的文档为准。
- Windows/macOS 安装包尚未接入代码签名，系统可能显示未签名提示。

## English

### Interface and workflows
- Refined the Modern interface across presales, bidding, official documents, grant applications, project collaboration, thesis assistance, software copyright, and patent workflows, with more consistent forms, lists, buttons, dialogs, and task feedback.
- Added project detail previews from project names, with a separate action to enter the workspace. Improved loading and error feedback and corrected the conflict between drawer header controls and the desktop window drag region.
- Organized the software copyright workspace into source code, registration, generation, draft review, and final checks/export stages. The usage guide is collapsed by default.
- Improved chapter navigation, stage outputs, and long-content layouts; removed internal outline identifiers from user-facing views and reduced redundant progress and completion banners.

### Settings and documents
- Aligned Modern settings sections, spacing, and status styling. Advanced model parameters and ComfyUI workflows can be expanded when needed.
- Fixed low-contrast Word reading previews by restoring white document sheets and readable text, tables, and code blocks.
- Improved library lists, image previews, export feedback, and access to images stored in feasibility projects. Clarified parsing errors for PDFs without a text layer.
- Improved update-check caching and rate-limit handling to reduce repeated requests and the impact of HTTP 429 responses.

### Notes
- This release focuses on the Modern interface while retaining Classic mode and existing business data.
- Word previews are intended for reading; use the exported document to check pagination and final formatting.
- Windows and macOS packages are not code-signed, so operating systems may display unsigned-app warnings.
